W5_separate_remaining_prerequisites: Independent source/input/runtime custody and fresh stages
Actual current scientific ledger and fresh one-use integrated admission
Fully numerical integrated disk/log/receipt bill and resource/measurement guards
Actual zero/nonzero/signal/normal/-O finite launcher/parser controls under their own admission
First baseline/candidate/full independent validation and paid P0-P5 disposition
current_limitations: No actual provider or timing utility digest supplied
No controls or imports executed in this source order

environment_policy.digit_limit: Capture and retain initial configured value; do not adjust for discovery

intended_host.binding_rule: Parent/operator must identify the exact current host and prove permission before any collection; historical paths and this chat cwd are not host attestation.
intended_host.historical_description: Trusted local Linux/CPython host; historical source names /usr/bin/python3.12 and x86_64 libraries
intended_host.selection: Local execution host intended for this CrocSwap operation

output_root_rule: Parent must create a new unaliased exclusive directory before admission; do not reuse an old stage, consumed marker, receipt or PASS. W3 has not created this root.

phases.action: Before launch, independently freeze exact tools, collector/launcher source, all fourteen profile entries/preloads, sources and intended host; review top-level import side effects and bytecode policy; install an exclusive operation marker and separate guarded budget/disk bill
phases.stop_if: Any null mandatory admission field, missing review, missing permission, stale ledger or unknown numerical guard remains.

phases.action: Start outer resource/timing/log observation before all collection; record trusted host/kernel/architecture/context supplied under admission; acquire actual executable version/build/flags/int/encoding metadata using only reviewed import-only collector profiles
phases.stop_if: Different host/flags/environment/provider shape; target main/control/helper/decoding attempted; child/log/RSS/time cap or uncertain reap.

phases.action: Collect origins, cached/frozen/builtin authorities, selected callable/code/default/global bindings and map dev/inode identities before/after each declared import-only profile; capture effective locale categories/codeset/UTF8/coercion; resolve exact actual ELF/native/provider/config dependencies under reviewed source rules Record native and startup file accesses, including non-mapped bytecode/config/message/locale data, with the pre-exec reviewed recorder or accepted complete source/configuration alternative.
phases.stop_if: Unexpected provider/module/map/config, deleted map, missing origin/code source, unsupported alias or unreviewed conditional helper.

phases.action: Boundedly hash and capture exact providers/locale/build/source evidence using regular descriptors with stable pre/open/post/path identities; retain immutable custody copies and manifest; review CPython JSON/long/helper and OpenSSL/zlib/loader source closure, including error branches
phases.stop_if: Cap exceeded, drift, lack of source-to-binary build evidence or inability to bind mapping to hashed bytes. Capturing bytes does not authorize relocation or prove they were loaded.

phases.action: Close all identities and process-tree receipts; preserve first evidence/failure, raw streams and costs; produce candidate acquisition manifest only; independent reviewer decides exact closure and authorizes a versioned runtime-manifest freeze if all requirements passed
phases.stop_if: Any unresolved provider/branch/custody/termination/accounting gap; do not amend allow-list from observed success or failure. No W5 starts.

profile_limitations: A profile with a null entry (future reviewed W4 source) blocks admission until its actual path/hash exists.
Import-only maps cannot prove all workload-dependent branches; source closure must include each helper or independently prove unreachability for the admitted domain/configuration.
Do not call observer/control fixture modes or serialize/parse authentic values to discover providers.
If review shows more than fourteen profiles or any cap insufficient, stop and propose a new separately reviewed acquisition version.

proposed_caps.cap_semantics: These are proposed maxima, not observed use. Root/supervisor overhead, file hashes/copies, failed profiles and final records consume the same 120s/1GiB-read/144MiB-write operation; never multiply the cap per child. Stop before any byte/file excess; no raised cap or retry.
proposed_caps.measurement_limitations: Sampled RSS is not true peak; record interval/PID race/shared-page/missed-peak limits. CPU is root plus wait4/reaped descendants counted once. Tracing/launcher/metadata/sealing/failed collection overhead is charged inside caps; incomplete termination/accounting prevents sealing.

sealing_requirements: Authenticated actual current host, executable/native/build source and exact launch semantics
Complete role/normal/-O/error/helper provider closure, not just successful-profile maps
Mapped-file identities match hashed file bytes and immutable custody; alias/drift rejected
Int conversion configuration/build-dependent branches and provider workspace premises dispositioned with W1
Intended locale authenticated or separate alternative-semantics review accepted
W2/W4 actual new source hashes and all dependent invalidations reclosed
Independent acquisition exact-scope review plus new immutable runtime freeze; no author self-admission
Non-mapped native/startup file reads and data/config/message-catalog identities closed by independent source or authorized pre-exec own-child file-access evidence

separate_operation.budget_ledger: Fresh separate concrete ledger and permission required; this proposal does not charge/reset/reaffirm historical scientific allowance.

tools_and_permissions.permission: Launch/observe/reap only this acquisition process tree; hard timeout and sampled RSS/log/disk guards, once-only consumption and locked separate ledger
tools_and_permissions.tool: Independently reviewed bounded launcher/supervisor, source and executable SHA required before admission

tools_and_permissions.permission: At most fourteen sequential import-only profiles; execute audited top-level imports/effective fingerprints, never call target main, controls, fixtures, loader decoding, serializer, validator or scientific helpers
tools_and_permissions.tool: Exact selected CPython plus pinned stdlib collector source

tools_and_permissions.permission: Read only exact preadmitted executable/provider/build/locale/import-cache/native-config files; reject aliases, special/deleted/replaced files and size excess before materialization; no broad filesystem search
tools_and_permissions.tool: Regular descriptor open/stat/fstat/lstat, SHA-256 and bounded copy; independently reviewed passive ELF/source parser

tools_and_permissions.permission: Read /proc/<collector-or-known-child-pid>/{maps,stat,status} and permitted map_files identities; join map dev/inode/offset with opened descriptors; no unrelated process/environment reads or root/ptrace privilege
Read exact supplied CPython/distributor source/build/config records and linked-provider provenance; no network or compiler fallback. Missing source evidence stops acquisition/sealing

If tracing is selected, separately authorize ordinary own-child tracing from before exec, limited to acquisition tree and file/provider/startup accesses, with no unrelated process reads or privilege escalation. Retain raw bounded logs; installed-after-startup Python audit events and maps alone are insufficient. Missing tracing permission without an accepted complete source alternative stops.
tools_and_permissions.tool: Independently pinned own-child startup file-access recorder or independently accepted equivalent source/configuration closure evidence
